sections.title: Closed dated Action protocol
sections.text: Exactly ten statuses and all 38 transition rows are recorded in action_lifecycle. No RFC enum values are added.

sections.title: Additive schemas and separate Run FSM
sections.text: platform_schemas lists logical entities, language adapters and applicability; Run is independent and remains planned.

sections.title: Preserved PHP/Dart consumers
sections.text: See docs/platform/sdk-consumers.json for exact package surface, native/direct/offline and optional companion obligations.

sections.title: Confirmation, idempotency and uncertainty
sections.text: Reuse trusted ports, tenant identities and fenced stores; local effect append is not a committed durable dispatch proof.

sections.title: Future breaking changes
sections.text: No breaking change proposed. Any wire/API break needs concrete owner question and future revision; no authority follows from absent Botkit consumers.

claims.statement: ALC-11 has exactly ten ActionStatus values; ALC-T1..T38 is the sole dated transition table. Internal RFC names are not serialized as statuses.

PHP/Dart reducers fold by seq, validate terminality before later events, fence effect outcomes by epoch, and preserve unknown event kinds without status change. The reducers are not authorization services.

prepare(actionId,toolName,arguments,preview) and commit(token,arguments) resolve actor/time/descriptor/context/policy/approval/authorization from trusted constructor ports. Consume follows binding checks and precedes current policy/approval/authorization; commit returns a token, not an executed domain effect.

Coordinator denies unknown high-risk before acquire, uses fenced leases, replays stored outcomes, and keeps unexpected exceptions distinct from known errors. Read-before-write takeover without a probe stores ambiguous; native_key may re-invoke under the same key. This does not permit blind retries of unknown effects.

EffectCommitter appends to the supplied local ActionJournal and then calls EffectApplier. It alone does not establish committed EventStore persistence before IO; a future durable dispatcher must prove it.
PHP production package remains agentools/sdk, AgenTools\ => src/, PHP >=8.3; reference/testkit/tests are dev autoload, not production imports. Reachability is not a stability promise.
Dart core remains agentools, SDK ^3.11.0, publish_to:none, public core barrel agentools.dart and separate testkit entry. MCP is optional private-paired and imports supported core only.

LlmPort.respond and ScenarioRunner remain current APIs. PHP supports IdempotencyKey or string run identity; Dart run retains IdempotencyKey and runWithId supplies string identity. Switching schemes changes keys; retries must retain the chosen persisted identity and scheme.
Internal Action mapping and independent Run FSM below are additive design contracts, not a new reducer or implemented runtime.
Independent AiResto/ERP/offline host bindings and deployment behavior are not inspected or live tested here; preservation is required even without an observed caller.
D1/D2/D3/D7 and owner-amendment-2026-10-31: one AgenTools platform, closed dated wire, external data owners, Botkit donor-only; no mandatory Botkit facade, data migration or rollout.

P1.2 records choice C separate transport, AgenTools sole future loop owner, no selected laravel/ai dependency and loop_proven:false. This is upstream design/offline evidence, not provider qualification.

decisions.decision: Keep dated 2026-09, namespace/package and PHP/Dart/offline direct Actions; platform v1 is additive.
decisions.rationale: Accepted execution-input D2 and observed package surface.

decisions.decision: Botkit is donor-only, no mandatory facade or data migration.
decisions.rationale: Owner amendment supersedes historical P1.1 migration recommendations; preserve actual AgenTools obligations.

limitations: Design/source matrix and focused tests only; no new runtime, durable dispatcher, host binding, provider live call or production readiness.
Independent AiResto/ERP callers are unverified, not absent; existing API obligations remain.
Raw plan schemas/examples are design samples, not an implementation or published protocol; conductor owns V1/V2/V3 and per-check receipts.
P1.4 must choose additive placement/dependencies from target evidence; P1.2 direct selection does not force laravel/ai or raise existing PHP SDK floor.
